# Settings reference

Every setting ano-mp keeps, under the section of Settings it is in, with the
value it has until you change it. [Chapter 11](11-settings.md) explains what
each one does. To open Settings, choose **ano-mp › Settings…** (⌘,).

Each section's **Reset to defaults** button (or **Reset**) puts that
section's settings back to the values below.

## General

| Setting | Starts as | Can be |
|---|---|---|
| Controls in the menu bar | Off | On or off |
| Keep the mini player above other windows | Off | On or off |
| Show each new track | Off | On or off |

## Library

| Setting | Starts as | Can be |
|---|---|---|
| Check the folders when ano-mp opens | On | On or off |
| Watch the folders for changes | On | On or off |

| Setting | Starts as | Can be |

| Views | Album artist, Genre, Year, Folder, Composer | views you add, change or remove |

## About

| Setting | Starts as | Can be |
|---|---|---|
| Check for updates automatically | Off | On or off |

The online sources' keys (a Discogs token, a ListenBrainz token) aren't settings:
they are kept in the macOS keychain, and none is saved at first. The folders in your
library and the recordings' folder are kept apart from the settings too.
